assignments.reason: Clapping hands in prayer (מחאת כפים בתפלה) is the sacred physical act that activates the hand-wing-lung speech apparatus. By essential nature it IS an act of the hands (ידיים) during prayer — the hands are NP-1's core anatomical domain. It is not merely a trigger for the מי/Binah dimension (that would be its causal role); its essential identity is a hand-action, and hands belong to NP-1. Polarity is good: the clapping is specified as 'בתפלה' — in prayer — making it a holy act of worship, not a neutral anatomical motion.

Striking palm to palm (מכה כף אל כף) is the same essential act as מחאת כפים בתפלה — physical hand-clapping. The כף (palm) is part of the יד (hand), and the hands are the external embodiment of the כנפי ראה (lung-wings) in NP-1. The node's essential nature is a hand-action: the physical gesture through which the hand-wing-lung bechina identity is activated. Its causal EFFECT (producing the number 50 / the mouth) flows to NP-2, but the act itself belongs to the physical-substrate package NP-1. Polarity is good: in the Torah's context this clapping occurs within the framework of prayer and produces holy speech.

assignments.node_id: נמצא שעל־ידי מחאת כף, חמשה אצבעות ימין בחמשה שביד שמאל וחמשה שביד שמאל בחמשה שביד ימין, נתהוה בחינת מי
assignments.package_label: מִי, חֲמִשִּׁין שַׁעֲרֵי בִּינָה, פֶּה וּגְאֻלָּה
assignments.reason: This compound node describes the emergence of בחינת מי — the bechina of the Divine name מי (= 50 = Binah). Although it mentions the mechanism of clapping (מחאת כף) and the arithmetic of five fingers (חמשה אצבעות), its essential identity is stated in its own conclusion: 'נתהוה בחינת מי' — the bechina of מי is formed. The node IS the moment where the physical act crystallizes into the spiritual dimension of מי/50/Binah. By essential nature it belongs to NP-2, the מי/Binah/liberation cluster, because its defining content is the emergence of מי. The arithmetic of 5×5×2=50 is the bechina-equivalence that makes clapping = 50 = מי — all NP-2 territory. Polarity: good (מי = Binah = liberation = holiness).

assignments.package_label: מִי, חֲמִשִּׁין שַׁעֲרֵי בִּינָה, פֶּה וּגְאֻלָּה
assignments.reason: This node describes the formation of the mouth (פה) through the power of מי. Its essential nature IS the פה — the divinely-formed mouth that is the culminating concept of NP-2. The text says 'מי שם פה לאדם — מי דיקא': the mouth is what מי (= Binah = 50 gates) places in a person. This node is the realization of the mouth-as-redeemed-speech, which is the core identity of NP-2. The פה formed here is the same פה that is bechina-equivalent to גאולה (redemption) and חמישין שערי בינה (50 gates of Binah). Polarity: good (the formed mouth = liberated speech = holy prayer).
